headlines.title: Ramaswamy says ad featuring Acton’s mother had nothing to do with allegations of sexual abuse
headlines.description: Ohio Republican gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy is defending the ad featuring his opponent Amy Acton’s estranged mother despite backlash from both parties. NBC News’ Priscilla Thompson explains.

headlines.title: Focus group: Supporters of losing primary candidates in Michigan & Texas weigh general election vote
headlines.description: Syracuse University’s Margaret Talev talks to a group of voters whose candidates lost primary races in Michigan and Texas. The focus groups were produced by Syracuse University and the research firms Engagious and Sago, observed by NBC News.

headlines.title: Send your questions for Steve Kornacki on the midterm elections
headlines.description: Election Day is quickly approaching and, with just over a week to go, Steve Kornacki is ready to answer your questions.

headlines.title: Trump administration cancels some Canada tariffs amid close midterm races
headlines.description: Sen. Susan Collins, who’s in a tough re-election fight, said she secured from the Trump administration tariff exemptions on some agricultural and forestry items.

headlines.title: Hero who stopped Bend school shooter haunted by encounter: ‘I didn’t save everybody’
headlines.description: Kaylub Giamanco speaks for the first time about the day he brought down a school shooter in Bend, Oregon.

headlines.title: How Starlink slowdown hit Ukraine’s front line soldiers pushing Russia back
headlines.description: The drone unit he leads has been helping push back Russian troops on the front lines in southeastern Ukraine.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: DOJ demands that California counties help identify noncitizen voters
headlines.description: The Department of Justice is warning local election officials in California to cooperate with the administration to identify noncitizens on a list of registered voters or face potential legal action, according to a letter obtained by NBC News.

headlines.title: Vanessa Trump says she is ‘cancer-free’ six months after diagnosis
headlines.description: Vanessa Trump, ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr., revealed Friday that she is cancer-free, after beginning treatment for breast cancer earlier this year.

headlines.title: More candidates are using AI in political ads to get your vote
headlines.description: At least 220 ads— mostly Republican— generated or enhanced with artificial intelligence have circulated in the leadup to the midterms, at a cost of almost $137 million.

headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.
